pr_title: Ignore inline comments when parsing nameservers
pr_body:
Motivation:

The resolv.conf file may contain inline comments which should be ignored

Modifications:

- Detect if we have a comment after the ipaddress and if so skip it
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9889

issue_context.title: java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string in UnixResolverDnsServerAddressStreamProvider
issue_context.body:
### Expected behavior
Not to throw exception

### Actual behavior
Throws exception.

### Steps to reproduce
Add comment to nameserver line in /etc/resolv.conf, for example:
nameserver 8.8.8.8 #vmm

This is automatically added by a VMWare process, and cannot be changed by me.

The error seems to occur because the IP is verified according to V4, but not enough measures are taken to ensure that Integer.parseInt is an actual int. (it tries to parse 8 #vmm)

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)
I am using this through Vert.x, so I don't really have code for this directly, but it was easy enough to reproduce on my personal computer by manually changing /etc/resolv.conf.

### Netty version
4.1.43.Final

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)
